text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Фудзи Кисэки and T.M.
Opera O
chatting excitedly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Us, produce an original work together?
Yes, that
sounds exciting!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I had a look at the script the other day,
but what
should we do about the cast?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hahaha! What a silly question! I shall be the lead, director, and producer all at once!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Now that that's out of the way, we must
decide
what to do with you, Fuji!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
You possess a beauty second only to
mine, and
your performance skills can
bedazzle any
audience!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: How do you plan to use your talents as a top star? That is the question!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Oh, stop it. You're making me
blush with all
that praise.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Who should I play, then? Hm...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Perfect timing. Who do you
think I
should be?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Fuji, I know he's your trainer, but he's
the
paradigm of a random passerby right
now.
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Fuji, I know she's your trainer, but she's
the
paradigm of a random passerby right
now.
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
It's a bit reckless to hand over such an
important
decision to an extra, don't you
think?
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Not at all. We've already decided
that
you'll be playing the lead.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And if you're the lead, then we must
figure out
what supporting role I should
play to best draw
out your charms.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Doing so is the job of an entertainer!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I think I see what you mean...
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Now, then! Who do you think I should
play,
Тренер? Don't hold back, even if it
feels like an
outrageous suggestion! ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: You should be the narrator and set the mood!

text_block_list.text:
What an unexpected casting choice! Do
you have
any experience playing such a
role, Fuji?
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: Not much, but I'll give it my all!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, we can try out a few lines
right now.
Ahem...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my prince, tell me true—what
meaning is
there to this thing we know
as fate?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The gods trap us with chains they dub
"fate" and
choose whom we must love...
But how can love
truly exist where
affection is forced?!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Fie on the gods and their ties of fate!
With mine
eyes have I seen your
valorous visage, and with
mine ears have
I heard your dulcet voice.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My lord, my faithful heart pines for your
love and
would choose none other than
you!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: M-my lady...
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
If such chains do restrict you so, then
with this
blade shall I sever them. Fear
not, for no
tribulation will break my will.
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Lady, with our hearts as one, none can
tear us
apart! This I do swear!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap! Wooo! That was amazing, you two!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text:
I'm so caught up in their performance
that I
applaud until my hands are sore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! We've attracted quite a crowd.
That was
stupendous.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Heh. You were just as fantastic!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
I really felt the way you drew out my
best
performance just now.
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
You were such a darling and an amazing
heroine!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: The narrator?! That's hardly a role!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
You think? I think the narrator can be a
pretty
significant part. Some plays
revolve entirely
around them, in fact.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Here, let me try being the invisible
presence that
stirs up our audience with
no more than my voice.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ahem...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Listen well, ye travelers of the night, to
this tale
of the prince who would carve a
path to glory
with his own might and
blade...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Wow! That narration is sending chills
down my
spine! You're incredible, Fuji!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Tick-tock, the pendulum swings twixt
glory and
demise as our hero prince
forges on in blind
pursuit of power!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's good! My palms are sweaty
with
anticipation for what comes next!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
He sprints onward, a gale of steadfast
ambition.
His sights still set on the
highest throne of the
land—that of the
Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, keep it up!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
No crook or bend in the path can slow
his gait as
he charges on!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
B-but of course not! If the narrator says
so, then
nothing can slow him!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Despite his exertions, he doth not
perspire! Not a
single drop of sweat
slicks down his forehead!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
That sounds highly unlikely, but maybe
it's
possible! Yes, it may be!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: Nnngh!
text_block_list.name: T. M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
Will our hero prince ever achieve his
goal of
becoming the Overlord?! Well,
that is something
only the wind
knows... ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки truly embodied her role as a
gallant
princess. I don't know when this
play is
happening, but I can't wait to
watch it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки seems to relish in spinning a
new tale
out of thin air. I don't know
when this play is
happening, but I can't
wait to watch it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
